title: LEG-199: server-owned MCP OAuth and controlled tools
summary: Automatic MCP callback declaration via usable CIMD/DCR, phone-manageable instance address, sealed credentials and default-deny tools. Scenario-tested proposal; no implementation before approval.

questions.prompt: Build remote Streamable HTTP connections and local controlled agents first?
questions.rationale: Worker forwarding, subprocess launches and hosted relays require separate trust and routing designs.

options.label: HTTP and local agents first
options.description: Defer worker forwarding, subprocesses, relay and device grant adapters.

questions.prompt: Reuse web.public_url when pinned, with once-per-instance phone Settings setup when absent?
questions.rationale: Legato generates every MCP redirect. The operator approves one trusted server address only if no canonical address exists; no untrusted Host/forwarded-header inference.

options.label: Reuse URL, onboard once if absent
options.description: Read pinned web.public_url; otherwise save an operator-approved HTTPS callback origin in Settings without a host-file edit/restart. No per-MCP redirect editor.

options.label: Always use a dedicated origin setting
options.description: Revise precedence and migration behavior before building.

questions.prompt: Require authenticated account/resource confirmation after the provider callback?
questions.rationale: Resolved on revision 1: Cameron selected confirm. Preserved here for reference; no new answer is required unless that decision changes. Callback state alone cannot activate a connection.

options.label: Confirm in authenticated Legato
options.description: Stage server-owned credentials, show account/resource, then activate. Grants remain separate.

options.label: Revise the activation design
options.description: Settle callback and operator trust before implementation.

questions.prompt: Use explicit agent reload for tool additions and immediate host denial for revocation?
questions.rationale: Existing agent tools discover MCP servers at session start. No running agent will be restarted automatically.

options.label: Explicit reload for additions
options.description: New/resumed executions reevaluate grants without another OAuth login.

options.label: Require live injection first
options.description: Revise scope and estimate to prove each adapter updates its model tool catalog.
